title: Kata Sound Lab
description: An original retro sound-effects workbench inspired by jsfxr. Start with a preset, shape a sound, and export a WAV for your next little world.

projectNotes: Inspired by jsfxr’s playful approach to sound design. This is an original learning project, not an official jsfxr app or a claim of feature-for-feature compatibility.
Editable settings use Kata Sound Lab’s own JSON format. jsfxr preset files are not compatible.

title: Kata Wave Room
tagline: Make room for the good parts.
description: An original audio-editing workbench inspired by Audacity. Open a mono or stereo clip, select the parts you want to shape, and export your edit as a WAV.

screenshots.alt: Kata Wave Room desktop editor with stereo waveform, selected audio range, editing controls and WAV export
screenshots.caption: Daylight study with a six-second selection in the desktop layout.

End-to-end file import was blocked by browser local-file permissions; native download completion was not independently verified. Screenshot provenance remains local, before the final edge-case fixes.
projectNotes: Inspired by Audacity’s hands-on approach to audio editing. This is an independent learning project, not an official Audacity app or a claim of feature-for-feature compatibility.
This first version edits one audio clip at a time. It does not offer Audacity’s full multitrack workspace, plugin system, or project-file compatibility.
Audio stays in your browser tab. Export your edits before closing or reloading. Import supports files up to 25 MB and three minutes, in formats your browser can decode.
